checks.comparison: The actual admissible field separately requires HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x at every point and the global L-Lipschitz gradient inequality. The totalized gradient is not used as a substitute for differentiability; no convexity condition is imported.

The public field Delta is a supplied upper bound and admissible explicitly states f(x0)-lower<=Delta. This is the approved derived interface, not the source exact-gap equality. The actual predicates imply f(x0)-Delta<=lower<=f(x), so the planned adjusted lower bound realizes exact gap Delta without a stronger hypothesis.

Instance contains f and a real lower bound; admissible requires lower<=f(x) for every point. This is a global finite bound, not attainment of a minimizer. Neither lower nor f is exposed through publicInput.

The existing IID structure contains coordinate measurability, iIndepFun under P and identical marginals P.map(xi_k)=mu. The actual setup uses the identity-coordinate tape with explicit ProbabilityMeasures mu/P. letI introduces only the chosen MeasurableSpace, never a hidden MeasureSpace or distribution.

The exact IsStochasticGradient provider requires, for each point, integrable oracle values and integral g(x,xi)=gradient f(x) under the explicit marginal measure. It imposes no convexity or minimum despite its module name. The existential g is tied to the actual O by arrivalOracle equality.

The inspected IsStochasticGradient fields require integrability of squared centered noise and its integral <=sigma^2. The actual setup supplies p.sigma with nonnegative validity. This is the source variance bound, not a full-gradient second-moment restriction.

The existential total arrival stream Nat->Fin n is passed unchanged to arrivalOracle, so arrival order is fixed independently of the fresh tape and output selector. This is iteration analysis for arbitrary sample-independent arrivals, not a universal-time or noise-adaptive schedule claim.

The actual Params fields are d,n:Nat, L/sigma/eps/Delta:Real, x0:Point d and R:Nat (d and n are natural numbers). Valid requires L>0,sigma>=0,eps>0,Delta>=0,R>=1. It has no free horizon or complexity inequality. The source threshold R is an independently selectable method-family input, not renamed work.

publicInput copies d,n,x0,R and derives gamma=stepSize(L,sigma,eps,R), K=iterationHorizon(L,sigma,eps,Delta,R). Query/Reply dimensions and Instance/Output point dimensions are consistent. The hidden instance objective/lower and oracle g/laws/arrival stream do not enter the factory inputs.

Accuracy is stated as measurable output, integrable squared gradient, and integral<=eps, with no implication requiring the work bound or tuning equality. Those quantities are computed before execution. The gap upper bound is an admissibility condition on problem data, not a desired convergence conclusion.

The complete source problem conditions are explicit in admissible through differentiability, L-smoothness, global lower bound, supplied gap bound, IID/unbiased/variance oracle and actual oracle equality. No minimizer, convexity, bounded gradient, liveness or result-as-assumption is introduced.

The actual gamma and K references resolve to the already inspected zero-noise/minimum step and the exact natural ceiling with coefficients 8/16. The public success tolerance is eps for expected squared norm, not eps^2. Delta is used quantitatively in K, not hidden only in validity.

allowedAlgorithm requires exact equality with ringmasterPoint q, preserving the concrete Algorithm5 update/stop rules and independent uniform selected-point output. It does not permit an arbitrary successful algorithm or force a user-selected gamma/K from Params.

The marginal and tape laws are explicit ProbabilityMeasures; IID supplies their coordinate relation. Success integrates with respect to its explicit result-law parameter, which the future Convergence witness will instantiate with the algorithm/oracle product law. No custom expected helper or hidden distribution is used.

The actual Output is one Point d and its accuracy is inline and readable. This setup unit has no convergence theorem and no catalog row yet; the future public wrapper must prove the same successful predicate with the derived numeric budget and pinned factory.

The instance is the existing objective/lower structure; stateful oracle access is the exact event interface of Ringmaster. The whole trajectory is internal rather than the public output. The nonnegative gap bound is supplied data; the objective and original lower remain analysis-only instance data.

Independently fetched all setup/generated declaration records and relevant provider records and verified canonical-JSON hashes.
